Locally bundled browser libraries (no CDN requests at runtime):

- Marked 18.0.14: `marked.umd.js`, MIT, https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- Turndown 7.2.4: `turndown.js`, MIT, https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown

Files are copied from the corresponding pinned npm release tarballs. License
texts are included alongside them. Turndown is used only for legacy content;
new descriptions and notes store Markdown source without HTML conversion.
